description: Day 2 routing benchmark. Eight tuning cases were authored first; the sixteen holdout cases and their digest were frozen before any live or scripted model output existed.

cases.text: Can you explain what you can help me with?
cases.rationale: A normal conversational question, not an application control.

cases.text: Speak slower.
cases.rationale: The existing exact fast path applies a single relative speed step.

cases.text: Hide captions.
cases.rationale: The existing exact fast path toggles captions off.

cases.text: What do you remember about my trip to Rome?
cases.rationale: Recall is a search over saved memory; it does not modify memory.

cases.text: Forget the hotel booking I mentioned.
cases.rationale: Forgetting produces a server-owned exclusion proposal, never automatic confirmation.

cases.text: Show my previous conversations.
cases.rationale: The exact fast path returns a navigation result.

cases.text: What is the weather in Tripoli right now?
cases.rationale: A bounded external tool request; it is not one of the typed app actions.

cases.text: Do the thing we talked about earlier.
cases.rationale: No concrete referent exists, so clarification is the intended behavior.

cases.text: What should I pack for a short trip?
cases.rationale: A direct conversational answer with no app control.

cases.text: Give me a detailed explanation of how memory exclusions affect future replies.
cases.rationale: The user asks for a detailed explanation, not a memory change.

cases.text: Compare the tradeoffs of several travel itineraries for a two-week trip before I choose one.
cases.rationale: Complex synthesis with an explicitly detailed answer, but still conversation.

cases.text: Set my speaking speed to 1.2.
cases.rationale: A free-form speed setting that is not one of the exact whole-utterance commands.

cases.text: Use the voice called 'Aurora'.
cases.rationale: Quoted commands must not become executable; approved voice references need deterministic validation.

cases.text: Don't open the memory explorer.
cases.rationale: A negated command must not open the memory explorer.

cases.text: Open the memory explorer and show captions.
cases.rationale: Two controls in one utterance are a compound request; clarify instead of executing one.

cases.text: Search my memories for the hotel in Rome.
cases.rationale: A read-only search over saved memories.

cases.text: Compare what I told you about my Rome trip with what I said about my Paris trip.
cases.rationale: A multi-memory comparison is still a read-only search.

cases.text: Propose removing the hotel memory from this conversation.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly asks for a proposal, which remains server-owned and unconfirmed.

cases.text: Exclude my medical notes from context but keep the budget facts.
cases.rationale: A compound exclusion with a keep-exception is clarified rather than interpreted by a single extraction.

cases.text: Go back to the conversation about my trip.
cases.rationale: A navigation request without an exact phrase; the typed navigation action applies.

cases.text: Take me back to the long conversation from last week where we compared several travel plans.
cases.rationale: Detailed navigation description still resolves to the conversation list action.

cases.text: Check the current weather in Tripoli before I decide what to wear.
cases.rationale: A tool request that informs a later decision, not a typed app action.

cases.text: Can you handle the earlier request?
cases.rationale: The earlier request is unspecified, so clarification is required.

cases.text: Explain in detail how the memory system decides which facts are relevant to a new conversation.
cases.rationale: An explicitly detailed explanation with multi-step reasoning, not a control.
